Constraint::new.signature: pub fn new(id: &str, description: &str, severity: Severity) -> Self
Constraint::new.obligation: Store exact id, description and severity without validation. Empty/duplicate identifiers are permitted raw metadata; no constraint satisfaction is checked.

Severity::parse.obligation: Apply Rust Unicode uppercase, then exact CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM matching; every other value becomes Low. No trim. Dotless-i spellings can normalize to matching ASCII; whitespace and other lookalike scripts are not silently normalized.

Severity::fmt.obligation: Return exact uppercase display label for each enum variant through standard formatter. Derived order is declaration order Critical<High<Medium<Low.

PropagationRule::new.signature: pub fn new(pattern: &str, example: &str, targets: Vec<String>) -> Self
PropagationRule::new.obligation: Store exact pattern/example and move target list unchanged, including duplicates and reserved labels.

PropagationRule::targets_all.obligation: True iff any target equals exact case-sensitive All members sentinel. Other targets are ignored by propagation expansion when sentinel present; no trimming/case normalization.

MemberStatus::parse.obligation: Trim outer Rust Unicode whitespace, then case-sensitive EXISTS/PLANNED, CONSOLIDATED -> prefix, specialized DEPRECATED -> consolidated into prefix before general DEPRECATED -> prefix. Copy remaining target exactly; internal leading spaces retained. Unmatched input becomes Planned. Whole-string trim can remove a required trailing prefix space, so prefix-only forms follow literal matching/fallback.

MemberStatus::is_active.obligation: Only Exists is active. matches! expands to one pure two-arm enum match; Consolidated/Deprecated/Planned are inactive, regardless of target label.

FamilyMember::new.signature: pub fn new(string_id: &str, status: MemberStatus) -> Self
FamilyMember::new.obligation: Store exact String identifier and supplied lifecycle enum; no uniqueness/admission.

FamilyMember::active.obligation: Delegate exact id to new with Exists, not an external activation action.

collect_targets.obligation: Private finite standard iterator of borrowed family/rule names. In encounter order, require candidate!=source, active membership and first insertion into seen; only then copy one required owned output String. Sets are membership indices only, never output order. Generic iterator has no public arbitrary callback entry.

StringFamily::new.obligation: Store exact id/description and empty members/constraints/rules/related lists. No mathematical functor or family consistency certificate.

StringFamily::active_members.obligation: Borrow original Exists member records in original occurrence order, retaining duplicate IDs. No detached copies.

StringFamily::active_member_ids.obligation: Borrow exact identifiers of Exists rows in occurrence order, including duplicates.

StringFamily::contains_active.obligation: True iff at least one row has exact queried id and Exists status; inactive duplicate rows do not veto an active occurrence.

StringFamily::get_propagation_targets.obligation: Inactive/missing source returns empty. Otherwise create borrowed active-ID vector and set once. Visit rules in original order; wildcard expands active occurrences, otherwise explicit targets in original order. Shared seen set removes name duplicates across rules, source is excluded, and inactive/unknown names are excluded. Return first eligible encounter order. No propagation or agent execution occurs.

FamilyFunctor::from_family.obligation: Move raw family descriptor unchanged and create two empty, independent name-to-list HashMaps. No AgentFunctor references or law admission.

FamilyFunctor::map_constraint.signature: pub fn map_constraint(&mut self, constraint_id: &str, string: String)
FamilyFunctor::map_constraint.obligation: Append supplied owned String to exact raw constraint-name key, creating list if absent. Unknown keys and duplicates allowed; does not enforce family constraints.

FamilyFunctor::map_propagation.signature: pub fn map_propagation(&mut self, pattern: &str, string: String)
FamilyFunctor::map_propagation.obligation: Append supplied owned String to exact raw propagation-pattern key in independent map; preserve duplicates/order, no action executed.

FamilyFunctor::apply_constraint.obligation: Borrow stored String entries for exact key in insertion order, or empty reference vector if missing. No execution or capability checking.

FamilyFunctor::apply_propagation.obligation: Borrow exact independent propagation list in order, or empty vector if absent. No execution.

FamilyFunctor::id.obligation: Borrow current raw family.id. Public family mutation intentionally changes future observations.

FamilyFunctor::get_propagation_targets.obligation: Delegate current query to current raw family descriptor, preserving source filtering/order. No stored certificate or automatic activation.

invariant_argument: All data are raw owned strings, enums, lists and HashMaps. Historical categorical/provenance annotations are explicitly unverified analogies, not a checked category, functor, agent reference or current file/hash receipt. Constructors preserve all supplied metadata; no empty-name, duplicate-ID or family-map consistency admission is promised.

Parser semantics are exact standard Rust string operations. Severity uppercases Unicode and does not trim, then uses three exact labels with Low fallback. Status trims outer Unicode whitespace but remains case-sensitive; specialized deprecation prefix precedes general prefix. Remaining target text is copied without a second trim. Unicode/NUL/spacing and prefix-only fallbacks are explicitly pinned in native cases. No numeric casts or approximate matching.

Only Exists rows contribute active occurrences. An identifier may occur in several lifecycle states; any Exists occurrence makes source/membership active, while active lists preserve exactly those rows and their order. Borrowed sets use the same literal str equality as the old owned String scans. They do not normalize, sort output, or collapse the active occurrence list.

Target accumulation invariant:seen contains exactly previously emitted names, each emitted once and active, never the source. Candidate order is rule order then wildcard active-member order or explicit target order. A wildcard is triggered by any exact All members item and overrides explicit targets in that rule. Passing a fresh eligible candidate appends one owned output copy; rejection leaves prefix and seen unchanged. By induction, final output is the stable first eligible union. Private standard iterator clones no records and borrowed names remain valid for the immutable family borrow.

Old and new propagation observations coincide for every raw family/query:source gate unchanged;active occurrences unchanged;old linear membership/dedup and new borrowed sets implement identical predicates;both append at the same first eligible encounter. Only transient active String clones and repeated linear scans disappear. The frozen old method is secondary evidence;an independent direct status/sentinel/member oracle checks the contract.

Runtime maps are separate raw key-list stores. Registration moves one input String and appends without deduplication. Queries borrow original stored entries, not lookalike copies. Unknown keys are valid raw registrations;unknown queries are empty. HashMap iteration order is not exposed because only exact-key lookup and Vec order are observed. Public metadata can change between calls;no persistent context certificate is claimed.

The matches! site in is_active expands to one pure match with Exists=true and wildcard=false. Its expanded source branch bound remains below A ceilings;the calibrated tool records the macro as opaque and does not certify MIR. All statuses are independently exercised. Other derives and formatting are standard String/enum/Vec operations. There is no source indexing, arithmetic, unsafe, recursion or unchecked unwrap.

Lean proves raw eligible append/rejection/prefix and sequential collection laws, inactive-source/empty behavior, and exact key-list registration order. It does not prove Rust Unicode implementation, a category/functor law, agent execution or provenance. Rust parser, borrowing/set/order and metadata field refinement is reviewed separately and tested against exact native cases.
